# Somos Hermanos

> Somos Hermanos is a Salvadoran foundation, the social arm of Tacos Hermanos. Every Sunday it delivers help baskets to children who need them in the Sonsonate area of El Salvador.

## What we do
Since 2021, Somos Hermanos brings food help baskets to children in the Sonsonate area of El Salvador, every Sunday of the year. Tacos Hermanos donates more than 300 baskets each Sunday, and the community adds their own by buying baskets at the restaurant. Each basket can carry a handwritten letter for a child. The foundation works hand in hand with the Sunday Bible School (Escuela Biblica Dominical) of Iglesia Bitinia to reach the families.

## How to help
- Buy a help basket (canasta de ayuda), or as many as you like, at any Tacos Hermanos restaurant in El Salvador.
- Write a message to the children; the letter is delivered with your basket.
- Baskets bought by Thursday are delivered that same Sunday; later donations are delivered the following Sunday.

## Who it is for
Anyone who wants to help children in need in the Sonsonate area of El Salvador, especially Tacos Hermanos guests who want their visit to also support a child.

## Proof
- More than 300 baskets donated every Sunday of the year by Tacos Hermanos.
- More than 5 years supporting children in Sonsonate.
- On one Sunday (12 April), 427 baskets were delivered: 300 from the foundation and 127 donated by the community.

## Belief
"Whoever loves God must also love their brother." (1 John 4:21). The world is a better place when we treat each other as brothers.

## Relationship with Tacos Hermanos
Somos Hermanos is the social arm (brazo social) of Tacos Hermanos, the Salvadoran taco restaurant group. It was born from Tacos Hermanos and shares its philosophy that small, repeated acts of kindness change lives.
